snippet.title: Silent Hill 2 port for the Nintendo 3DS - Tutorial and gameplay
snippet.description:
Silent Hill 2 now runs natively on the Nintendo 3DS. sh23ds is my homebrew port of the PC Director's Cut, rebuilt in C from the original exe and drawn with the 3DS GPU, so there's no emulator involved. The Enhanced Edition fixes come built in. In this video I go through the full install, from packing your own game files in the browser to installing the CIA with 3dsDL, and then play from the bathroom mirror up to the first Lying Figure fight.

Download and install guide: https://ankush.one/sh23ds/
Discord community: https://discord.gg/bmsGepbS5Y
Follow my startup on X: https://x.com/use_construct

WHAT WORKS (v0.2.2)
All 17 areas, all 128 cutscenes, all six endings, New Game+ and Born From a Wish are built. The game plays on the top screen, and the map, items and memos are on the touch screen. The PC fog is there too, including James pushing it aside as he walks. On a New 3DS you get the full settings. Old 3DS and 2DS run a lighter 30 fps profile with fewer fog sprites and no character shadows. (NOTE: I havent tested on the O3DS yet as I only have the N3DS)

WHAT YOU NEED
- Any 3DS or 2DS with custom firmware (Luma3DS) and FBI or 3dsDL
- Your own copy of "legally acquired" Silent Hill 2 PC, Director's Cut (v1.0 isn't supported yet)
- About 1.5 GB free on the SD card
No CFW yet? Start here: https://3ds.hacks.guide/

HOW TO INSTALL
1. Open the packer at https://ankush.one/sh23ds/packer.html and pick your Silent Hill 2 folder. Everything runs inside your browser and nothing gets uploaded. If you're on an Old 3DS or 2DS, turn the Old 3DS movies option on. It usually takes 5 to 10 minutes depending on your PC.
2. Unzip the result and copy the sh23ds folder to the /3ds folder of your SD card, so the data ends up in sdmc:/3ds/sh23ds/*
3. Install sh23ds.cia with 3dsDL or FBI by scanning the QR code on the site.
4. Start Silent Hill 2 from the HOME Menu.
No sound? Run DSP1 once: https://github.com/zoogie/DSP1/releases
Full guide with troubleshooting: https://ankush.one/sh23ds/install.html

CHAPTERS
0:00 What you need
0:16 Building the game data in your browser
0:56 Saving the zip
1:12 Copying to the SD card
2:00 Installing the CIA with 3dsDL
2:56 First boot
3:20 Opening movie
3:44 The bathroom
4:16 The parking lot
5:12 Grabbing the map
5:28 Forest trail
6:40 First save point
7:04 Meeting Angela
8:08 Road into town
8:40 Fog glitch fix
10:56 Blood on the road
12:00 Toward the tunnel
12:48 First Lying Figure
13:36 First fight

KNOWN ISSUES
Mannequins don't drop from ceilings yet, Maria can't look around or point, the music doesn't react to danger, and movies have no subtitles. Water, bloom, rain and smoke effects are still on the roadmap. If you get blocky fog like at 8:40, turn off complex fog in Options.
Roadmap: https://ankush.one/sh23ds/roadmap.html
Report a bug: https://github.com/ankushKun/sh23ds/issues

LINKS AND TOOLS
sh23ds source code: https://github.com/ankushKun/sh23ds
All releases: https://github.com/ankushKun/sh23ds/releases
3dsDL, which downloads files and installs CIAs straight on your 3DS: https://ankush.one/3dsDL/ (can also be used for wireless file transfer and more)
Silent Hill 2 Enhanced Edition: https://enhanced.townofsilenthill.com/SH2/
Luma3DS: https://github.com/LumaTeam/Luma3DS
My site: https://ankush.one

The game has sound. My capture setup just didn't record it, so the music in this video is from the Silent Hill 2 soundtrack by Akira Yamaoka.

sh23ds is a free fan project under the GPLv3 and has no affiliation with Konami or Nintendo. Releases contain no game code or assets, so you need your own PC copy of Silent Hill 2. Silent Hill is a trademark of Konami Digital Entertainment, and Nintendo 3DS is a trademark of Nintendo.

I make homebrew for free. If you want to support me, follow https://x.com/use_construct on X and come hang out in the Discord.

#SilentHill2 #Nintendo3DS #3DSHomebrew
